author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

ONNX Runtime 1.30 builds the CUDA and MIGrpahX execution providers as a plugins.
This PR switches cms::Ort::ONNXRuntime to the plugin execution provider API for CUDA, and uses the same mechanism to add support for AMD GPUs with the MIGraphX execution provider.
It makes the ONNX Runtime environment (env_) non-const, as required to register the execution provider libraries.

###### NVIDIA GPUs: CUDA execution provider
Register `libonnxruntime_providers_cuda.so` with the ONNX Runtime environment once per process, and add the first CUDA device to the session options with `AppendExecutionProvider_V2`.
Throw an exception if no CUDA device is available.

###### AMD GPUs: MIGraphX execution provider
Add a `Backend::rocm` option to `cms::Ort::ONNXRuntime::defaultSessionOptions`. It registers the MIGraphX execution provider library (`libonnxruntime_providers_migraphx.so`) once per process and adds the first AMD GPU to the session options, the same way as for CUDA.

Note that MIGraphX recompiles the model whenever the input shapes change from one call to the next, so it is best suited for models with fixed input shapes, e.g. a fixed or padded batch size.

Add a unit test for the ROCm backend that disables the CPU fallback, to make sure the model runs on the GPU.

#### PR validation:

Units test pass.
title: Run ORT on GPU using CUDA and MIGraphX execution providers
